# partiteai_a2ui_basic_form (Data Source)

Builds the definition of an A2UI task form from components of the A2UI v0.9 basic catalog, for the `A2UI` entry of a task definition's `ui_forms`. Each component is a `component` block with one block for its type, such as `text` or `button`, whose attributes are the type's properties in snake case. A property that can be bound to the data model or come from a function call has `_path` and `_call` forms beside it: set `text = "Hi"`, `text_path = "/greeting"`, or `text_call = jsonencode({ call = "formatString", args = { value = "Hi $${/name}" } })`. The form is checked against the catalog when it is read. Checks that need the task's schemas, such as whether an action's context fits the output, happen when the task definition is saved. For a custom catalog, use `partiteai_a2ui_form`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `completed` (Block, Optional) The surface that replaces the open one once the task is completed, with the task output as its data model. It can't have event actions. Without it, the surface is removed once the task is completed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--completed))
- `open` (Block, Optional) The surface shown while the task is open. Its data model starts as the task input, and every event action completes the task with its context as the output. Required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open))

### Read-Only

- `definition` (String) The form's definition, as JSON. Use it as the `A2UI` entry of a task definition's `ui_forms`.

### Nested Schema for `completed.component.accessibility`

Optional:

- `description` (String) Additional information provided by assistive technologies about an element such as instructions, format requirements, or result of an action. For example, a mute button might have a label of 'Mute' and a description of 'Silences notifications about this conversation'. Set at most one of `description`, `description_path` and `description_call`.
- `description_call` (String) Sets `description` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `description_path` (String) Binds `description` to a JSON pointer in the data model.
- `label` (String) A short string, typically 1 to 3 words, used by assistive technologies to convey the purpose or intent of an element. For example, an input field might have an accessible label of 'User ID' or a button might be labeled 'Submit'. Set at most one of `label`, `label_path` and `label_call`.
- `label_call` (String) Sets `label` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `label_path` (String) Binds `label` to a JSON pointer in the data model.

Optional:

- `button` (Block, Optional) The Button component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--button))
- `card` (Block, Optional) The Card component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--card))
- `check_box` (Block, Optional) The CheckBox component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--check_box))
- `choice_picker` (Block, Optional) A component that allows selecting one or more options from a list. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--choice_picker))
- `column` (Block, Optional) A layout component that arranges its children vertically. To create a grid layout, nest Rows within this Column. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--column))
- `date_time_input` (Block, Optional) The DateTimeInput component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--date_time_input))
- `divider` (Block, Optional) The Divider component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--divider))
- `icon` (Block, Optional) The Icon component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--icon))
- `image` (Block, Optional) The Image component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--image))
- `list` (Block, Optional) The List component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--list))
- `modal` (Block, Optional) The Modal component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--modal))
- `overlay` (Block List) Sets a value of the component from the task input when the task starts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--overlay))
- `row` (Block, Optional) A layout component that arranges its children horizontally. To create a grid layout, nest Columns within this Row. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--row))
- `slider` (Block, Optional) The Slider component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--slider))
- `tabs` (Block, Optional) The Tabs component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--tabs))
- `text` (Block, Optional) The Text component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--text))
- `text_field` (Block, Optional) The TextField component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--text_field))
- `video` (Block, Optional) The Video component. Set exactly one component type block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--video))
- `weight` (Number) The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

<a id="nestedblock--open--component--accessibility"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.accessibility`

Optional:

- `description` (String) Additional information provided by assistive technologies about an element such as instructions, format requirements, or result of an action. For example, a mute button might have a label of 'Mute' and a description of 'Silences notifications about this conversation'. Set at most one of `description`, `description_path` and `description_call`.
- `description_call` (String) Sets `description` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `description_path` (String) Binds `description` to a JSON pointer in the data model.
- `label` (String) A short string, typically 1 to 3 words, used by assistive technologies to convey the purpose or intent of an element. For example, an input field might have an accessible label of 'User ID' or a button might be labeled 'Submit'. Set at most one of `label`, `label_path` and `label_call`.
- `label_call` (String) Sets `label` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `label_path` (String) Binds `label` to a JSON pointer in the data model.


<a id="nestedblock--open--component--audio_player"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.audio_player`

Optional:

- `description` (String) A description of the audio, such as a title or summary. Set at most one of `description`, `description_path` and `description_call`.
- `description_call` (String) Sets `description` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `description_path` (String) Binds `description` to a JSON pointer in the data model.
- `url` (String) The URL of the audio to be played. Required. Set exactly one of `url`, `url_path` and `url_call`.
- `url_call` (String) Sets `url` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `url_path` (String) Binds `url` to a JSON pointer in the data model.


<a id="nestedblock--open--component--button"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.button`

Optional:

- `action` (Block, Optional) What the component does. Set an `event` block or `function_call`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--button--action))
- `check` (Block List) A list of checks to perform. These are function calls that must return a boolean indicating validity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--button--check))
- `child` (String) The ID of the child component. Use a 'Text' component for a labeled button. Only use an 'Icon' if the requirements explicitly ask for an icon-only button. Required.
- `variant` (String) A hint for the button style. If omitted, a default button style is used. 'primary' indicates this is the main call-to-action button. 'borderless' means the button has no visual border or background, making its child content appear like a clickable link.

<a id="nestedblock--open--component--button--action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.button.action`

Optional:

- `event` (Block, Optional) Completes the task, with the context as its output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--button--action--event))
- `function_call` (String) Runs a function on the client, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.

<a id="nestedblock--open--component--button--action--event"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.button.action.event`

Optional:

- `context` (String) The task output, as a JSON object. A value can be a literal or a binding, such as `jsonencode({ confirmed = true, note = { path = "/note" } })`.
- `name` (String) The name of the event. Required.



<a id="nestedblock--open--component--button--check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.button.check`

Required:

- `message` (String) The error message to display if the check fails.

Optional:

- `condition` (Boolean) Set exactly one of `condition`, `condition_path` and `condition_call`.
- `condition_call` (String) Sets `condition` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `condition_path` (String) Binds `condition` to a JSON pointer in the data model.



<a id="nestedblock--open--component--card"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.card`

Optional:

- `child` (String) The ID of the single child component to be rendered inside the card. To display multiple elements, you MUST wrap them in a layout component (like Column or Row) and pass that container's ID here. Do NOT pass multiple IDs or a non-existent ID. Required.


<a id="nestedblock--open--component--check_box"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.check_box`

Optional:

- `check` (Block List) A list of checks to perform. These are function calls that must return a boolean indicating validity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--check_box--check))

- `label_call` (String) Sets `label` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `label_path` (String) Binds `label` to a JSON pointer in the data model.
- `value` (Boolean) The current state of the checkbox (true for checked, false for unchecked). Required. Set exactly one of `value`, `value_path` and `value_call`.
- `value_call` (String) Sets `value` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `value_path` (String) Binds `value` to a JSON pointer in the data model.

<a id="nestedblock--open--component--check_box--check"></a>

- `condition` (Boolean) Set exactly one of `condition`, `condition_path` and `condition_call`.

<a id="nestedblock--open--component--choice_picker"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.choice_picker`

Optional:

- `check` (Block List) A list of checks to perform. These are function calls that must return a boolean indicating validity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--choice_picker--check))

- `filterable` (Boolean) If true, displays a search input to filter the options.

- `value_path` (String) Binds `value` to a JSON pointer in the data model.

<a id="nestedblock--open--component--column"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.column`

Optional:

- `align` (String) Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (horizontally). This is similar to the CSS 'align-items' property.
- `children` (List of String) The IDs of the child components. Set this or a `children_template` block.
- `children_template` (Block, Optional) Makes a child for each item of a list in the data model. Set this or `children`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--column--children_template))
- `justify` (String) Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (vertically). Use 'spaceBetween' to push items to the edges (e.g. header at top, footer at bottom), or 'start'/'end'/'center' to pack them together.

<a id="nestedblock--open--component--column--children_template"></a>

Optional:

- `path` (String) The path to the list in the data model. Required.



<a id="nestedblock--open--component--date_time_input"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.date_time_input`

Optional:

- `check` (Block List) A list of checks to perform. These are function calls that must return a boolean indicating validity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--date_time_input--check))
- `enable_date` (Boolean) If true, allows the user to select a date.
- `enable_time` (Boolean) If true, allows the user to select a time.
- `label` (String) The text label for the input field. Set at most one of `label`, `label_path` and `label_call`.
- `label_call` (String) Sets `label` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `label_path` (String) Binds `label` to a JSON pointer in the data model.
- `max` (String) The maximum allowed date/time in ISO 8601 format. Set at most one of `max`, `max_path` and `max_call`.
- `max_call` (String) Sets `max` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `max_path` (String) Binds `max` to a JSON pointer in the data model.
- `min` (String) The minimum allowed date/time in ISO 8601 format. Set at most one of `min`, `min_path` and `min_call`.
- `min_call` (String) Sets `min` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `min_path` (String) Binds `min` to a JSON pointer in the data model.
- `value` (String) The selected date and/or time value in ISO 8601 format. If not yet set, initialize with an empty string. Required. Set exactly one of `value`, `value_path` and `value_call`.
- `value_call` (String) Sets `value` to a function call, as JSON: `{"call": ..., "args": {...}}`.
- `value_path` (String) Binds `value` to a JSON pointer in the data model.

<a id="nestedblock--open--component--overlay"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.overlay`

Required:

- `expression` (String) A CEL expression that sees the task input as `input`, such as `input.options.map(o, {'label': o, 'value': o})`. An empty optional, such as `input.?subtitle`, removes the value.
- `pointer` (String) A JSON pointer to the value in the component as A2UI writes it, with property names in camel case, such as `/text` or `/action/event/context/answer`.


<a id="nestedblock--open--component--row"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open.component.row`

Optional:

- `children` (List of String) The IDs of the child components. Set this or a `children_template` block.
- `children_template` (Block, Optional) Makes a child for each item of a list in the data model. Set this or `children`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component--row--children_template))
- `justify` (String) Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (horizontally). Use 'spaceBetween' to push items to the edges, or 'start'/'end'/'center' to pack them together.

<a id="nestedblock--open--component--row--children_template"></a>

Optional:

- `path` (String) The path to the list in the data model. Required.
